data.standardized_narrative: The gross claims development triangle shows a net adverse movement (strengthening) of approximately GBP 8.66m for prior years (2011-2014 aggregate movement when excluding the two most recent underwriting years). The managing agent's narrative reports a prior period reserve deterioration of GBP 10.8m (likely quoted on a net-of-reinsurance basis) attributed to adverse experience across property, marine and third party liability. PerLOB net movements in the Movement in Prior Year's Provision note show adverse development concentrated in Third Party Liability, partially offset by favourable movements in Marine and Accident & Health.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary prior-year development figure derived from the GROSS claims development table (triangle) per instructions. The movement note titled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' in the notes appears to present NET amounts (the note header states 'net provision'), which total a net deterioration of GBP 10.764m; that net figure differs from the gross triangle-derived movement of +GBP 8.664m. PerLOB movements shown in the Movement note are therefore treated as net amounts and are included in lob_movements with lower confidence. Gross triangle was used as the authoritative gross PYD source per extraction rules.
